Pastor Enoch Adeboye of the Redeemed Christian Church of God has talked down accusations directed at him of purportedly carrying a placard in a prayer walk during the time of former President Goodluck Jonathan’s administration. The Presidential Campaign Council of the opposition party — the African Democratic Congress — has challenged the All Progressives Congress to account for President Bola Tinubu’s failure to fulfil his 2023 campaign promise on electricity. The opposition party recalled that the president had made an unequivocal pledge that Nigerians should not vote for him for a second term if he failed to deliver electricity during his first four-year tenure. After years of being single, the Senior Pastor of Fountain of Life Church, Lagos, Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, has introduced his new wife, Pastor Mo Odukoya, to his congregation during Sunday service on November 1, 2026, at the church headquarters in Ilupeju, Lagos State. The recap in full: 1. I did not carry placard in protest against Jonathan — Adeboye The General Overseer of the Redeemed Christian Church of God, Pastor Enoch Adeboye, has accused journalists of misrepresenting the date he carried a placard during a prayer walk, alleging that the report falsely linked the incident to former President Goodluck Jonathan’s administration. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources Adeboye said the incident occurred in 2020, five years after Jonathan left office in 2015, insisting that the walk was organised to pray against insecurity and killings in the country. The cleric spoke to his congregation on Sunday during the church’s November Thanksgiving service, where he recounted how the report portrayed him as a wicked man for carrying a placard allegedly against the former president. Read more here . 2. ADC tackles Tinubu, APC over ‘unfulfilled power supply pledge’ The African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council has challenged the All Progressives Congress to account for President Bola Tinubu’s failure to fulfil his 2023 campaign promise on electricity, insisting that no amount of political explanations can erase his commitment to Nigerians. The opposition party recalled that the president had made an unequivocal pledge that Nigerians should not vote for him for a second term if he failed to deliver electricity during his first four-year tenure. In a statement issued on Sunday, the ADC-PCC Director of Media and Publicity, Kola Ologbondiyan, said the APC’s attempt to explain or reinterpret the President’s remarks through selective quotations was an afterthought aimed at escaping accountability. Read more here . 3. Fountain of Life pastor Jimmy Odukoya introduces new wife to congregation The Senior Pastor, Fountain of Life Church, Lagos, Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, has introduced his new wife, Pastor Mo Odukoya, to his congregation. The pastor made the announcement during Sunday service on November 1, 2026, at the church headquarters in Ilupeju, Lagos State. Earlier on Saturday, he posted an image of two hands with wedding rings on his Instagram page, with the caption “To New Beginnings.” Read more here . 4. 2027: Osun can deliver 1.5 million votes for Tinubu — Oyetola The Minister of Marine and Blue Economy, Adegboyega Oyetola, has called for unity among political interests in Osun State ahead of the 2027 general elections, expressing confidence that President Bola Tinubu could secure 1.5 million votes in the state. The former Osun State governor urged members of the All Progressives Congress to intensify grassroots mobilisation and work towards securing maximum votes for all the party’s candidates in the elections. Oyetola made the call in an address obtained on Sunday at the launch of the 10,000-member door-to-door canvassers’ initiative under the aegis of the PBAT Door-to-Door Movement, an initiative sponsored by Government Ekpemupolo, popularly known as Tompolo, to support Tinubu’s re-election.
